description: The east corner of the tenth floor, glass on two sides: the bay on one and the long grey run of Coldwater on the other, the light crossing the room all day without ever being harsh. A bath cut from a single block of stone behind the bedroom wall. Leave west to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 10-E
